content.answer: Never rebuild an id-referenced single-select option list from names alone — merge by stable id: pass every existing option object through unchanged (same id and name), and only append genuinely new names with fresh ids starting at max(existing id)+1; rebuilding by name makes the API mint new ids and silently clears every existing row's value.
content.reuse_advice: For any catalog update where items are referenced by id: fetch the current list, diff by stable id, keep existing items byte-for-byte as-is, assign new ids only to truly new entries starting after the current max id, and never treat the update payload as a full replacement keyed by display name — doing so severs all existing references and data loss is silent.
